immersivefx.menu.title: ImmersiveFX
immersivefx.menu.noneChanged: No settings differ from their defaults.
immersivefx.menu.restart: Applies after you rejoin the world.
immersivefx.menu.page.sound.desc: How sounds are processed and placed.
immersivefx.menu.page.soundList.desc: Block, cull, preview or scale any sound.
immersivefx.menu.page.mobEffects.desc: Item sounds, player and mob effects.
immersivefx.menu.page.specialFx.desc: Sounds and particles for everyday actions.
immersivefx.menu.about.enhancedSounds: Adds reverb and filtering, so sounds react to the space around you.
immersivefx.menu.about.hrtf: Head-related audio processing for better direction on headphones.
immersivefx.menu.about.monoConversion: Converts stereo sound files to mono, so they can play from a position in the world.
immersivefx.menu.about.panningSoftness: How much a sound right beside you is also heard on the other ear. 0 is hard panning.
immersivefx.menu.about.occlusion: Muffles sounds that are behind blocks.
immersivefx.menu.about.occludeWeather: Also muffles rain and thunder behind blocks.
immersivefx.menu.about.occludeRecords: Also muffles jukebox music behind blocks.
immersivefx.menu.about.loopCrossfade: Makes looping sounds such as biome ambience and waterfalls seamless.
immersivefx.menu.about.loopCrossfadeLeng: Length of the crossfade. At most a quarter of the loop is used.
immersivefx.menu.about.fadeInTime: How long a positional loop such as a waterfall takes to fade in and out.
immersivefx.menu.about.playerSounds2D: Plays your own diving, swimming and splashing in stereo at your position.
immersivefx.menu.about.playerSounds2DLis: Sounds that play in 2D when they come from you.
immersivefx.menu.about.cullInterval: Ticks between repeats of a sound marked Cull. 0 turns culling off.
immersivefx.menu.about.startupSounds: One of these plays when the game reaches the main menu.
immersivefx.menu.about.spotVolume: Volume of short random sounds around you.
immersivefx.menu.about.ambience3D: Plays ambience from several points around you, so it pans when you turn.
immersivefx.menu.about.ambienceDirection: 0 is evenly all around you, 100 is only from the directions the biome lies in.
immersivefx.menu.about.waterfallCutoff: Only waterfalls stronger than this make a sound.
immersivefx.menu.about.seaLevel: Overrides the sea level used for ambience. 0 uses the value of the world.
immersivefx.menu.about.dimensionBlacklis: Dimensions where biome sounds do not play.
immersivefx.menu.about.footstepSounds: Replaces footstep sounds with ones that match the block you walk on.
immersivefx.menu.about.armorAccents: Adds armor sounds to your steps.
immersivefx.menu.about.rainAccents: Adds splashes to your steps in the rain.
immersivefx.menu.about.waterAccents: Adds water sounds when you walk on waterlogged blocks.
immersivefx.menu.about.cadence: Times your own steps for the first person view.
immersivefx.menu.about.quadruped: Your footsteps sound like a horse.
immersivefx.menu.about.toolbar: Plays a sound when you switch to an item in your hotbar.
immersivefx.menu.about.swing: Plays a sound when you swing an item.
immersivefx.menu.about.hidePotionParticl: Keeps potion particles of your player out of your view.
immersivefx.menu.about.breath: Shows your breath in cold regions and under water.
immersivefx.menu.about.arrowTrail: Shows a particle trail behind flying arrows.
immersivefx.menu.about.effectRange: How many blocks around you entity effects are handled.
immersivefx.menu.about.disableUnderwater: Turns off the vanilla particles under water.
immersivefx.menu.about.fog: Turns all fog effects of this page on or off.
immersivefx.menu.about.biomeFog: Fog density and color per biome.
immersivefx.menu.about.elevationHaze: More haze the higher you are.
immersivefx.menu.about.morningFog: Fog in the morning that burns off over time.
immersivefx.menu.about.weatherFog: More fog the stronger it rains.
immersivefx.menu.about.minFogDistance: Fog never ends closer than this share of your render distance.
immersivefx.menu.about.auroraBands: How many aurora bands can show at once.
immersivefx.menu.about.lightMode: Which light level the overlay shows.
immersivefx.menu.about.lightHideSafe: Hides numbers on blocks where mobs cannot spawn.
immersivefx.menu.about.lightThreshold: The light level at which mobs can spawn.
immersivefx.menu.about.fxEnabled: Turns all sounds and particles of this page on or off.
immersivefx.menu.about.bloodSplatter: Splatter sound when you hit with a sword, axe or pickaxe.
immersivefx.menu.about.bloodParticles: Blood particles when entities are hurt.
immersivefx.menu.about.crafting: Sound when an item is crafted.
immersivefx.menu.about.smelting: Sound when you take an item out of a furnace.
immersivefx.menu.about.itemDrop: Sound when you throw an item away.
immersivefx.menu.about.workstationClicks: Sound when you use a crafting table, furnace, anvil and similar blocks.
immersivefx.menu.about.inventoryOpen: Sound when you open your inventory.
immersivefx.menu.about.mobSpawn: Sound when a monster or animal appears.
immersivefx.menu.about.mobSpawnSmoke: Smoke puff when a monster or animal appears.
immersivefx.menu.about.oreBreak: Sound when you mine an ore.
immersivefx.menu.about.oreBreakReplace: Plays it instead of the vanilla break sound.
immersivefx.menu.about.stoneBreakReplace: Plays it instead of the vanilla break sound.
immersivefx.menu.about.hunger: Stomach growl when your food bar is low.
immersivefx.menu.about.bed: Sound when you lie down in a bed.
immersivefx.menu.about.chat: Sound when a chat message is sent.
immersivefx.menu.about.typing: Click when you type in the chat or a text field.
immersivefx.menu.about.streamingSounds: Number of channels for streamed sounds.
immersivefx.menu.about.workers: Threads for sound calculations. 0 is the default.
immersivefx.menu.about.replaceRandoms: Replaces client random generators with faster ones.
immersivefx.menu.about.versionCheck: Shows the result of the online version check.
immersivefx.menu.about.debugCore: Writes debug messages of the core to the log.
immersivefx.menu.about.debugSound: Writes debug messages of the sound system to the log.
immersivefx.menu.about.debugEnvirons: Writes debug messages of the environment effects to the log.
immersivefx.menu.about.debugMobs: Writes debug messages of the mob effects to the log.
